build_torchvision_transforms_pipeline: build a TorchvisionTransforms processor from an OmegaConf config to compose torchvision transforms into a pipeline
create_grayscale_to_rgb_processor: create a GrayScaleTo3Channels processor that tiles a single channel grayscale tensor into 3 channels
build_resize_shortest_processor: build a ResizeShortest processor that resizes images by their shortest side within min and max size bounds
create_normalize_bgr_processor: create a NormalizeBGR255 processor to convert RGB to BGR255, normalize, and optionally pad images to a fixed size
build_vilt_image_processor: build a VILTImageProcessor that resizes, converts to tensor, handles grayscale, and normalizes images for VILT models
